clean_checkpoint_single_file: clean a single PyTorch checkpoint file by removing unnecessary data and keeping only state_dict and meta
clean_checkpoint_directory: clean all PyTorch checkpoint files in a directory by removing unnecessary data recursively
parse_args_checkpoint: parse command line arguments to get checkpoint directory or single checkpoint path for cleaning
run_clean_checkpoints_cli: run the clean checkpoints CLI tool to process .pth files in a directory or single file
review_clean_checkpoint_function: review the clean_checkpoint function that loads a checkpoint and saves only state_dict and meta
